title: File:Musicians and dancers from ottoman empire.jpg
description:
The Surname-I Hümayun (Imperial Festival Book) were albums that commemorated celebrations in the Ottoman Empire in pictorial and textual detail.
  • Here, musicians and dancers entertain the crowds, found in the Surname of 1720.
